title: The BEZERU Blueprint: How We Judge Watches
excerpt: The lens we use to review modern and vintage watches—design, ergonomics, movement choices, and what actually matters on the wrist.
content: Welcome to BEZERU. This is our editorial lens—simple, consistent, and obsessed with details that affect real wear.
We care about proportion first: dial-to-case balance, lug length, and how the watch reads from arm’s length.
Then ergonomics: crown comfort, clasp design, strap taper, and the subtle stuff that makes a watch disappear on-wrist.
Finally: movement decisions—because engineering choices always show up in the design.

title: Vintage vs Modern: Where the Value Really Is
excerpt: A collector’s guide to buying better: originality, service history, and the biggest mistakes new buyers make.
content: Vintage value is rarely about hype—it's about condition, originality, and honest documentation.
Modern value is about execution: finishing, wearable design, and brand behavior over time.

title: Release Radar: 5 Watches Worth Your Time This Week
excerpt: A clean scan of releases—what changed, what’s noise, and what’s genuinely interesting.
content: This week’s radar focuses on small improvements that matter: bracelet taper, dial legibility, and thickness.
The best releases usually look boring in photos—until you understand the design decisions.
